lines.en: : Hey, Miku. What are you doing right now?
: A whole lotta nothin'! Come talk to me about stuff!
lines.zh: : 啥也没干！快来跟我说说话！

lines.en: Miku lets me into the room and the two of us proceed to 'talk about stuff.'
lines.zh: Miku 让我进了房间，然后我们两个就开始“说说话”。

lines.en: We go through the usual routine of her rambling on about soccer and other drama that has been going on with the team while I...
lines.zh: 我们照例走了一遍老流程：她滔滔不绝地讲足球，讲队里最近发生的各种破事，而我……

lines.en: We go through the usual routine of her rambling on about swimming and other drama that has been going on with the team while I...
lines.zh: 我们照例走了一遍老流程：她滔滔不绝地讲游泳，讲队里最近发生的各种破事，而我……

lines.en: Well, I just do my best to keep up...which is a lot harder than you might expect.
lines.zh: 嗯，我只能尽全力跟上……这可比你想象的难多了。

lines.en: Miku is like a ball of lightning constantly ricocheting off of everything in its path.
lines.zh: Miku 就像一团球状闪电，不停地从它路径上的每一样东西上弹开。

lines.en: And don't get me wrong, I like being a lightning rod just as much as any guy would, but-
lines.zh: 别误会，我跟任何一个男人一样乐意当那根避雷针，不过——

lines.en: Well, let's just say I wouldn't mind if she slowed down every once in a while.
lines.zh: 嗯，这么说吧：她要是能偶尔慢下来一点，我也不介意。

lines.en: We wind up playing some card game that Miku made up for a couple hours until Makoto tells her she's on the way home.
lines.zh: 最后我们玩了几个小时 Miku 自己编的纸牌游戏，直到 Makoto 跟她说该回家了。

lines.en: Strange...it feels like I just got here. It's crazy how quickly time flies when I'm with Miku.
lines.zh: 真奇怪……感觉我才刚到。和 Miku 在一起的时候时间过得真快，快得离谱。

lines.en: But, yet again, it might just be that time is trying to catch up to her...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也可能只是时间在拼命追赶她罢了……
